title: Agents docked editor part
description: The Agents window's docked editor part on the right (`#workbench.parts.editor.part.editor` under `.dock-detail-panel`, inside the workbench `.monaco-grid-view`): a connected tab bar (e.g. Changes · Files · Customizations, the + Add Tab dropdown and Maximize Editor Area) above the active editor. With `workbench.editor.useModal: off`, editors such as Customizations open here as a tab instead of in a modal (captured from VS Code Insiders 1.145.0, 2026-10-29 build). Verification: 874 elements compared against the live docked Skills page in both themes; the only differences are the virtualized list's total scroll height (the product sizes `.monaco-list-rows` for all 32 skills; the example lists the User group) and an invisible disabled sash that belongs to the hidden auxiliary bar.
usage: Right-hand docked editor area of the Agents window. Wrap in <vsc-workbench window="agents"> and give it a height. Set `tabs` and `active`; listen for `tab-select`, `tab-close` and `tab-add` events to make tabs interactive. Put the active editor in the default slot.

states.name: active-tab
states.description: Active tab: top border, selected background, close action visible.
